Description: The nacelle external contour shall minimize aerodynamic drag and provide smooth airflow to the engine inlet under all flight conditions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Drag coefficient within ±2% of design target; inlet distortion ≤15%

Description: The thrust reverser shall deploy within 2 seconds of actuation command and achieve rated reverse thrust within 3 seconds.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deployment time ≤2 seconds; reverse thrust ≥40% rated thrust

Description: The nacelle inlet shall maintain acceptable pressure recovery and flow distortion across the flight envelope.
Acceptance_Criteria: Pressure recovery ≥97% at design point; DC60 ≤0.05

Description: The nacelle exhaust system shall efficiently discharge core and bypass flows with minimal mixing losses.
The nacelle assembly weight shall not exceed design target while maintaining all structural and functional requirements.
